methodology: Official public DLD latest-vintage snapshots. Projects require registered number + unique unchanged English name + stable developer identity + compatible official geography, independently reviewed. Community links are administrative area context only. No fuzzy joins, interpolation, future prices, event uplift, or historical point-in-time availability claimed. Raw rows stay private. Usage/type/registration and native subtypes remain explicitly separate; Ejari business property types (including Virtual Unit) are separate; sparse medians retained with n20 display gate. Entire duplicated single-property rental contracts are quarantined; invalid/future start or extreme end dates independently quarantined. Aggregate series overlap and are not additive. New specific first-party project proofs supplement unchanged exact native names/IDs; both raw-source and later identity-review availability are retained. Registered Land/Building asset histories remain published_reference and cannot anchor marketed Unit/Villa prices. Earlier packets are unchanged. All 77 Luma Park Views rental aggregates remain retained but disputed and withheld from usable coverage and anchors. Community association revisions retain previous relationships and reject only explicitly identified legacy context links.
